# Ram Chandel

## DC Principal | Global Commerce Lead

[Pleasanton, US](https://www.deloitte.com/us/en/offices/office-locator/pleasanton.html)

## Ram Chandel

## DC Principal | Global Commerce Lead

## Get in touch

Fields marked with an asterisk (\*) are required.

Ram has more than 20 years of experience in defining and building large and complex global digital business solutions for leading international brands across multiple industries, making him a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of the complexities and challenges of the field. This wealth of experience has given him a unique perspective on the evolution of digital commerce and how businesses can leverage technology to create exceptional customer experiences and drive business growth. Ram's extensive knowledge and expertise make him a highly sought-after consultant and advisor, trusted by businesses to guide them through their digital transformation journeys.

Throughout his career, Ram has focused on building high-performing global teams that consistently deliver excellence in execution. He is highly skilled in building and operating omnichannel commerce businesses involving digital marketing, creative, commerce platform engineering, cyber, self-service, and change management, driving delivery excellence, and optimizing processes for superior results.

Ram is always looking ahead to the future of e-commerce and the latest technological innovations, especially during unprecedented times of COVID-19 that demanded a shift to digital commerce as a lifeline of the economy. He is particularly excited about the potential of emerging technologies, such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Augmented Reality/Virtual Reality (AR/VR), Internet of Things (IoT), and Immersive/3D, to create new and exciting customer experiences.

When he's not working, Ram enjoys staying active with golfing and cycling, as well as following his favorite sport, cricket. Ram is an enthusiastic listener of Audible audiobooks, particularly those centered on world human history, which he approaches with a scholarly curiosity and a passion for learning.
